name: Daily Standup
description: Two palette commands: what you did since yesterday (from git and the sessions) as a standup note, and a plan for today.

commands.title: Standup: what I did since yesterday

action.text: Write my standup note. Run `git log --since=yesterday --oneline` and `git diff --stat HEAD~5` in this project, then summarise in three bullets: done, in progress, blockers. Plain text, no headings.
Look at the open TODO and FIXME comments in the source (grep, at most 40 lines) and the last 10 commits, and propose a plan for today: three items, one line each, most valuable first.
